purpose: What qualifies as evidence that a source refund happened, and what may supply its amount. A gateway field name is never evidence.

qualifications.note: A canonical refund entity is the refund record itself, not a signal that needs a second producer to confirm it.
Corroborates an entity but cannot establish a refund on its own and cannot supply a missing amount.
No gateway currently qualifies. Adding one requires that gateway's own documentation.
May corroborate an authoritative record once its semantics are documented. It never creates a refund.
One weak signal, not two independent ones, however many fields the callback wrote.

excludedKeys.reason: Observed carrying the full refundable order total on essentially every order of this gateway, written at payment time. Treating it as a refund would refund that gateway's whole revenue.
Observed as a single constant value across every order of this gateway. A field with one value discriminates nothing.
A raw provider blob whose sibling fields carry customer personal data. A refund contract that requires parsing it is not one that can be honoured safely.
Refund-shaped keys for this gateway are unsurveyed and undocumented. Field names are not evidence.
Refund-shaped keys for this gateway are unsurveyed and undocumented. Field names are not evidence.

amountSources: The qualified refund entity's own amount. Nothing else.
Never the order total, and never a gateway refundable-balance field.
writeContract: Resolve the parent order through the order crosswalk.
Resolve an existing eligible target payment. If none exists, do not fabricate one; report refund-without-payment.
Add Payments runs before Refund Payments only when a real payment was produced and is not already present.
Every paymentRefunds[].externalRefund occurrence is the hardcoded literal true, with no caller override.
Omit side effects. Never place the source refund date in a customer-visible reason field.
Count every written refund in refund-date-not-preserved; the target refund date is read-only.
Import an authoritative total at order level and report refund-line-detail-not-preserved. Invent no line ids.
